类 ConsoleSink

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.ConsoleSink
所有已实现的接口:
ProgressSink, AutoCloseable
public final class ConsoleSink extends Object implements ProgressSink
Console output.

In an interactive terminal (detected via System.console() != null) frames overwrite the previous ones in place using ANSI cursor movement, like wget/docker. In a redirected/piped stream it falls back to one frame per block of lines so log files stay readable.
